protocol.initial_matching: full physical state at equal mass centers, orientation, pusher, and target mass center
protocol.reset_selection: common rotated geometry/clearance checks; reject for all selected shapes
protocol.T_construction: unchanged official mass/inertia/CoG and legacy reset
protocol.L_construction: area-centroid coordinates and uniform-density inertia; same total mass

protocol.source_flags: unchanged upstream done; separate runner stop reason

evaluation.metric: mean of maximum clipped upstream rewards; distinct from success fraction
